title: EXPLORING THE ETHICAL CONCERNS IN USER REVIEWS OF MENTAL HEALTH APPS USING TOPIC MODELING AND SENTIMENT ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Topic modeling (LDA) and sentiment analysis of user reviews to identify complaints about biased chatbot responses and decision-making.
Analysis of user reviews identifying themes of alienation due to Western-centric therapy language and lack of cultural sensitivity in AI responses.
Qualitative analysis of user reviews regarding the lack of support for non-English languages and culturally specific expressions.
Evaluation of user reviews concerning high subscription costs and paywalls that create uneven access for lower-income users.
Analysis of user reviews highlighting accessibility issues for users with visual, auditory, or motor impairments.
